architecture: Preserve P4 V1 as immutable failed execution lineage.
Create P4 V2 as a separate notebook and runtime identity.
Keep the six A-F experimental cases and request order unchanged.
Use one runtime-environment helper for import and worker subprocesses.
Place target-installed NVIDIA libraries before inherited loader paths.
Remove CUDA stub directories from runtime and compilation paths.
Use the real NVIDIA driver directory for link and runtime fallback.
Install the full hash-locked offline dependency closure.
Fail immediately when the worker exits before readiness.
Bound retained stdout and stderr tails to 128 KiB per stream.
Validate libcusparse and libnvJitLink origins after worker readiness.
Require a separate post-merge execution authorization.
rejected_alternatives: Do not mutate or replay P4 V1.
Do not rebuild the governed wheelhouse.
Do not change prompts, schemas, or selection rules in the compatibility fix.
Do not use LD_PRELOAD as an opaque global workaround.
Do not retain unrestricted worker or import logs.
